audit.why: FAVOURED 4/10 fits 51.76% over 2189 games and the kit reality: Lux has no dash, no escape, and one 10s root.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page named no cooldowns, and the content layer guessed one wrong: early says Light Binding is '8s+ at rank 1'. Riot's value is a flat 10 at every rank.
audit.why: The step-up window is exactly the 10 seconds after a missed Binding; a wrong number moves the whole plan.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns now carries Light Binding 10s flat, Lucent Singularity 10s at rank 1, Prismatic Barrier 12s; early corrected.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two interactions were absent — Prismatic Barrier shields on the outward throw AND on the return pass, so a single early cast eats your burst twice; and Illumination detonates on her NEXT AUTO, so the auto wind-up is the damage tell, not the spell cast. Worse, the page claimed Defiant Dance blunts her combo.
audit.why: Defiant Dance reduces PHYSICAL damage taken. Lux's entire kit is magic damage, so holding W to tank her Q-E-R does nothing.
audit.corrected: dosFull[1].d covers the double-pass shield, dontsFull[0].d covers the Illumination tell, and every 'W shreds her burst' claim is removed from tldr, phases[1].why, early and spikes[0].text.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[6] and spikes[3].text credit Defiant Dance with tenacity ('stacking tenacity from W'). Irelia's W grants no tenacity at all.
audit.why: Riot's W text: charges a strike, reduced physical damage taken while charging. Nothing about tenacity.
audit.corrected: Both rewritten around her lack of any dash instead.

audit.why: phases[N].side and win[N] both read Irelia on all seven rows and match the packet levelChart — no chart work needed.

edits.after: Her combo is one window and yours is every other — dodge Light Binding, dance the gap, and stun her while it is down.

edits.before: Shred the one window his kit owns and own all the others. Nothing here works through Light Binding — schedule your pattern around its cooldown.
edits.after: Own every window her one root does not. Light Binding is a flat 10 seconds — schedule your pattern around it and a miss leaves her with no escape.

edits.before: - Lux Light Binding: matchup-defining — Everything keys off the root — minion-block it and her combo never starts. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget W Defiant Dance for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.

edits.before: If Lux opens the score, reset expectations and respect Light Binding doubly. After a second, your job description changes — farm with Q resets and stay relevant through stacked windows.
edits.after: If Lux opens the score, respect the 1175 range on Light Binding — walk inside the wave so a minion eats it, farm with Bladesurge resets, and step up the second it misses.

edits.before: Carry through the dance — the wave funds dives no cooldown can, and your R turns skirmishes into no-exit interviews.
edits.after: Carry through the dance — she owns no dash and no escape, so Vanguard's Edge onto her ends the fight where it starts.

edits.before: Lux's Light Binding has an 8s+ cooldown at rank 1 and if she misses it or uses it to clear a caster minion, you have a full window to Q onto her free of retaliation punish; her only answer once E lands is flashing, which just cedes the wave. You out-trade her point-blank because Ionian Fervor stacks and Defiant Dance's damage reduction blunt her Q-E combo, and she has no hard peel besides the root itself.
edits.after: Lux's Light Binding is a flat 10s cooldown and if she misses it or uses it to clear a caster minion, you have a full window to Q onto her free of retaliation punish; her only answer once E lands is flashing, which just cedes the wave. You out-trade her point-blank on Ionian Fervor stacks alone — Defiant Dance cuts physical damage, so dodge her magic combo rather than tanking it.

edits.before: Once you have Q-W-E you can dash onto Lux the instant her Light Binding whiffs or is used to zone a minion, and Defiant Dance shreds the burst from her Lucent Singularity/Final Spark combo before she can layer it.
edits.after: Once you have Q-W-E you can dash onto Lux the instant her Light Binding whiffs or is spent zoning a minion, and with that 10s root down the Lucent Singularity slow is all she has left to keep you off her.

edits.before: Even with a full-build Lux hitting Q-E-R from max range, your Defiant Dance stacking tenacity and gap-close via Q into backline makes you the priority threat she has to flash away from.
edits.after: Even with a full-build Lux hitting Q-E-R from max range, your Bladesurge gap-close into the backline makes you the threat she has to Flash away from, since she never gains a dash.

edits.before: Late game your dive potential and tenacity from W outpace her scaling poke, so you stay ahead
edits.after: Late game your dive potential outpaces her scaling poke, since Lux never gains a dash to escape it

notes: Two kit errors corrected across several fields: (1) Defiant Dance was described as blunting Lux's burst and as granting tenacity — Irelia's W reduces PHYSICAL damage only and grants no tenacity, and Lux's whole kit is magic, so the old advice told the reader to tank what they should dodge. (2) early gave Light Binding an '8s+' cooldown; it is a flat 10s at every rank. Added the Prismatic Barrier double-pass shield and the Illumination auto-attack tell from _missing. Level chart is consistent across both layers and the packet — untouched. breakdown.wave and breakdown.early remain templated.
